content:
Happy to announce the release of Trellis!

This is an autoformalization system aimed at the task "formalize this .tex paper" into Lean, with no guidance.

It runs LLM agents in a framework with careful process semantics enforced by a deterministic kernel, aiming to solve the problem of enforcing real incremental progress in autoformalization tasks.

The manuscript is here:
https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09674

Github source here:
https://github.com/wpegden/trellis

Website linking to formalizations in pretty viewers here:
https://www.math.cmu.edu/~wes/trellis.php

The formalizations we link to are of recent breakthroughs in Ramsey theory.

Discussion here:
#Autoformalization > Trellis
